passages.text: Northwind builds routing software for parcel networks across Europe. Founded 2019, 40 people, Berlin and Lisbon.

## How we hire
Every engineer goes through: a 30-minute intro call, a paid four-hour take-home, a 60-minute system design session, and a values interview.
